Of the Ister. Hecataeus in his Europe. Τίριζος, a people of Paphlagonia. But Ctesias says that they are Τιριζιβανοί in the second book: “and from the Odrysians to the Τιριζιβανοί dwelling in Paphlagonia.” Κρόβυζος, a people by the Ister toward the south wind. Hecataeus in his Europe. Λόκοζος, a city of Phrygia; but Xanthus the Lydian writes it with ξ. Κάττουζος, a people of Thrace.

Triform words and those derived from adverbs are accented with an acute: πεζός, χθιζός, πρωϊζός. μαζός is noted as exceptional, because, though it is of one form, it is accented with an acute. Perhaps, then, the Ionians are more in accordance with analogy when they say μαστόν.

The pure disyllables of one form ending in -θος, with the penult naturally long, ought to be accented with a grave: κῶθος; likewise κωβίος; μῦθος; Ζῆθος; Σῆθος, a river of Scythia, as Philostephanus says; Ξοῦθος, the proper name: “both Δῶρος and Ξοῦθος” (Hesiod. fr. XXXII Goettl.). Βοῦθος, victor at the Pythian games. Proverb: “Βοῦθος wanders about,” in Cratinus’ Cheirones; and it is applied to the simple-minded and thick-witted. Νοῦθος, a proper name; and ψόφος, which Hesiod knows in the third book: “and a dull thudding of feet arose.” Λῆθος, a proper name.

Therefore στρουθός, being accented with an acute, is exceptional; but Chaeiris says that the Attic speakers accent the word with a grave, as Tryphon also mentions in the second book On Attic Accentuation. Yet perhaps it differed from the foregoing, since it is also used in the masculine—“and swift στρουθοί were leading (them)”—and in the feminine—“but when she had eaten her own young, and the στρουθοῖο herself” (Β 326).

Disyllables in -θος of one form, having the syllable before the end ending in a consonant, are accented with a grave: πτόρθος, γόνθος, that is, κόγχος.

def isolated_page(browser):
    context = browser.new_context(
        viewport={"width": 1100, "height": 800}, service_workers="block"
    )
    blocked_requests = []

    def deny(route):
        blocked_requests.append(route.request.resource_type)
        route.abort()

    context.route("**/*", deny)
    return context, context.new_page(), blocked_requests


def exercise(browser, item, scenarios):
    context, page, blocked_requests = isolated_page(browser)
    errors = []
    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append("page error"))
    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append("console error")
            if message.type == "error" else None)
    checks = []
    try:
        frame = mount(page, item)
        scenarios(page, frame, checks)
        record(checks, "Candidate made no external requests or browser errors",
               [[], []], [blocked_requests, errors])
        return checks
    finally:
        context.close()


def confinement(browser):
    # Only this test prefab refers to a reserved domain. The route aborts any request
    # that reaches interception, even if the production CSP fails to block it.
    probe = {
        "original": {"ref": "1.246", "greek_text": "", "english_translation": None},
        "candidate": {
            "html": '<form action="https://browser-probe.invalid/form">'
                    '<button type="submit">Test form policy</button></form>',
            "css": "",
            "js": """
                window.violations = [];
                document.addEventListener("securitypolicyviolation", (event) => {
                    window.violations.push({
                        directive: event.effectiveDirective, blocked: event.disposition
                    });
                });
                const img = document.createElement("img");
                img.alt = "";
                img.src = "https://browser-probe.invalid/image";
                document.body.append(img);
                fetch("https://browser-probe.invalid/connect").catch(() => {});
            """,
        },
    }
    context, page, blocked_requests = isolated_page(browser)
    checks = []
    try:
        frame = mount(page, probe)
        frame.get_by_role("button", name="Test form policy").click()
        iframe = page.locator(".gadget-frame")
        actual_frame = iframe.element_handle().content_frame()
        actual_frame.wait_for_function("window.violations && window.violations.length >= 3")
        violations = actual_frame.evaluate("window.violations")
        record(checks, "Production iframe and CSP enforce image, connection and form blocks",
               ["allow-scripts allow-forms", [
                   ["connect-src", "enforce"], ["form-action", "enforce"], ["img-src", "enforce"]
               ]],
               [iframe.get_attribute("sandbox"),
                sorted([event["directive"], event["blocked"]] for event in violations)])
        record(checks, "Confinement probes produced no outbound request or form navigation",
               [[], "about:srcdoc"], [blocked_requests, actual_frame.evaluate("document.URL")])
        return checks
    finally:
        context.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    bundle = json.loads(args.bundle.read_text())
    binary = which("chromium") or which("chromium-browser") or which("google-chrome")
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(
            executable_path=binary, args=["--disable-background-networking"]
        )
        try:
            security = confinement(browser)
            report = {}
            for role, scenarios in (("new", new_cases), ("past", past_cases)):
                item = bundle[role]
                checks = exercise(browser, item, scenarios) + security
                report[role] = {
                    "browser": f"Chromium {browser.version}",
                    "candidate_sha256": digest(item["candidate"]),
                    "assertions": checks,
                }
        finally:
            browser.close()
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

original.english_translation:
Of the Ister. Hecataeus in his Europe. Τίριζος, a people of Paphlagonia. But Ctesias says that they are Τιριζιβανοί in the second book: “and from the Odrysians to the Τιριζιβανοί dwelling in Paphlagonia.” Κρόβυζος, a people by the Ister toward the south wind. Hecataeus in his Europe. Λόκοζος, a city of Phrygia; but Xanthus the Lydian writes it with ξ. Κάττουζος, a people of Thrace.

Triform words and those derived from adverbs are accented with an acute: πεζός, χθιζός, πρωϊζός. μαζός is noted as exceptional, because, though it is of one form, it is accented with an acute. Perhaps, then, the Ionians are more in accordance with analogy when they say μαστόν.

The pure disyllables of one form ending in -θος, with the penult naturally long, ought to be accented with a grave: κῶθος; likewise κωβίος; μῦθος; Ζῆθος; Σῆθος, a river of Scythia, as Philostephanus says; Ξοῦθος, the proper name: “both Δῶρος and Ξοῦθος” (Hesiod. fr. XXXII Goettl.). Βοῦθος, victor at the Pythian games. Proverb: “Βοῦθος wanders about,” in Cratinus’ Cheirones; and it is applied to the simple-minded and thick-witted. Νοῦθος, a proper name; and ψόφος, which Hesiod knows in the third book: “and a dull thudding of feet arose.” Λῆθος, a proper name.

Therefore στρουθός, being accented with an acute, is exceptional; but Chaeiris says that the Attic speakers accent the word with a grave, as Tryphon also mentions in the second book On Attic Accentuation. Yet perhaps it differed from the foregoing, since it is also used in the masculine—“and swift στρουθοί were leading (them)”—and in the feminine—“but when she had eaten her own young, and the στρουθοῖο herself” (Β 326).

Disyllables in -θος of one form, having the syllable before the end ending in a consonant, are accented with a grave: πτόρθος, γόνθος, that is, κόγχος.

"""Run with Playwright and Chromium from the repository root against a gadget bundle."""
import argparse
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import which
from unittest.mock import patch

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

from cloud_gadgets import digest
from generate_site import render_passage


class GadgetFrame(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.frames = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == "iframe" and dict(attrs).get("class") == "gadget-frame":
            self.frames.append(self.get_starttag_text())


def mount(page, item):
    row = item["original"]
    with patch("generate_site.render_shell", side_effect=lambda *, title, body_html: body_html):
        passage = render_passage(
            site_title="Herodian", ref=row["ref"], summary=None,
            greek_text=row["greek_text"], english_translation=row["english_translation"],
            **{"gadget_" + part: value for part, value in item["candidate"].items()},
        )
    parser = GadgetFrame()
    parser.feed(passage)
    assert len(parser.frames) == 1
    page.set_content(
        '<!doctype html><style>body{margin:0}.gadget-frame{width:100%;height:390px;'
        'display:block;border:0}</style>' + parser.frames[0] + "</iframe>"
    )
    return page.frame_locator(".gadget-frame")


def visible(frame, selector):
    node = frame.locator(selector)
    node.wait_for(state="visible")
    return node.inner_text()


def record(checks, case, expected, actual):
    if not isinstance(expected, str):
        expected = json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        actual = json.dumps(actual, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
    passed = actual == expected
    assert passed, f"{case}\nExpected: {expected}\nActual: {actual}"
    checks.append({"case": case, "expected": expected, "actual": actual, "passed": passed})


def fitting(frame):
    return frame.locator("body").evaluate("(node) => node.scrollWidth <= node.clientWidth")


def new_cases(page, frame, checks):
    field = frame.locator("#word")

    def lookup(value):
        field.fill(value)
        field.press("Enter")

    def answer():
        return [visible(frame, selector) for selector in ("#match", "#group", "#pattern")]

    prompt = "Enter a Greek example or choose one above."
    early = "Accent before the final syllable"
    acute = "Acute on the final syllable"

    record(checks, "Empty lookup prompt", prompt, visible(frame, "#note"))
    lookup("  ΠΕΛΟΨ  ")
    record(checks, "Unaccented ΠΕΛΟΨ from the ο/ε group",
           ["Πέλοψ", "Ending in -οψ or -εψ", early], answer())
    lookup("πλινθοβαψ")
    record(checks, "Distinct -αψ exception identifies Herodian’s contrast",
           ["πλινθοβάψ", "Ending in -αψ", acute,
            "Herodian expressly names this and πελεθοβάψ as exceptions to the -αψ pattern."],
           answer() + [visible(frame, "#note")])
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="λαῖλαψ", exact=True).first.click()
    record(checks, "λαῖλαψ follows the earlier-accent pattern",
           ["λαῖλαψ", "Ending in -αψ", early], answer())
    frame.locator("#related").get_by_role("button", name="πλινθοβάψ", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Related-example button returns to the exception",
           ["πλινθοβάψ", "Ending in -αψ", acute], answer())
    lookup("βου\u0342κλεψ")
    record(checks, "Decomposed -εψ example has the earlier accent",
           ["βοῦκλεψ", "Ending in -οψ or -εψ", early], answer())
    lookup("χερνιψ")
    record(checks, "χέρνιψ belongs to the -ιψ group",
           ["χέρνιψ", "Ending in -ιψ", early], answer())
    record(checks, "Desktop layout fits and controls share a row", [True, True],
           [fitting(frame), field.bounding_box()["y"] ==
            frame.get_by_role("button", name="Look up").bounding_box()["y"]])

    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 320, "height": 760})
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Τῖρυνς", exact=True).first.click()
    record(checks, "Narrow layout fits and the city’s example remains operable",
           [True, ["Τῖρυνς", "Two final consonants", early]],
           [fitting(frame), answer()])
    frame.locator("#related").get_by_role("button", name="ἅλς", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Monosyllable comparison gives the final acute",
           ["ἅλς", "Two final consonants", acute], answer())
    lookup("λόγος")
    record(checks, "Unlisted word clears prior word and comparisons",
           [True, True, "This word is outside the example list. Try one of the Greek words above."],
           [frame.locator("#match").is_hidden(), frame.locator("#related").is_hidden(),
            visible(frame, "#note")])
    lookup("   ")
    record(checks, "Whitespace restores the empty prompt", prompt, visible(frame, "#note"))
    lookup("τιρυνς")
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Clear").click()
    record(checks, "Clear empties and focuses the input and hides stale results",
           ["", True, True, prompt],
           [field.input_value(), field.evaluate("(node) => document.activeElement === node"),
            frame.locator("#match").is_hidden(), visible(frame, "#note")])


def past_cases(page, frame, checks):
    field = frame.locator("#inp")

    def check(value):
        field.fill(value)
        field.press("Enter")

    def answer():
        return [visible(frame, "#outWord"), visible(frame, "#rule")]

    long_note = "Naturally long penult with a circumflex in Herodian’s one-form -θος examples."
    final_note = "Final acute in Herodian’s group of three-gender or adverb-derived forms."
    prompt = "Enter a Greek example or choose one of the examples."

    record(checks, "Seeded μῦθος has the passage’s circumflex",
           ["μῦθος", "μῦθος — " + long_note], answer())
    check("Ξουθος")
    record(checks, "Distinct Ξοῦθος has the circumflex on its diphthong",
           ["Ξοῦθος", "Ξοῦθος — " + long_note], answer())
    check("πρωιζος")
    record(checks, "Unaccented πρωϊζός restores diaeresis and final acute",
           ["πρωϊζός", "πρωϊζός — " + final_note], answer())
    check("πρωι\u0308ζο\u0301ς")
    record(checks, "Decomposed marks give a single attested spelling",
           ["πρωϊζός", "πρωϊζός — " + final_note], answer())
    check("Τιριζος")
    record(checks, "Τίριζος retains the earlier accent in the ethnonym",
           ["Τίριζος", "Τίριζος — Earlier accent in the name of a Paphlagonian people."],
           answer())
    check("μαζος")
    record(checks, "μαζός is explained as a one-form exception",
           ["μαζός", "μαζός — Herodian marks it as exceptional because it has one form and a final acute."],
           answer())
    check("στρουθος, πτορθος")
    record(checks, "Phrase preserves the comma and explains both words",
           ["στρουθός, πτόρθος",
            "στρουθός — Herodian marks the final acute as exceptional. Chaeiris reports a non-final Attic accent.\n"
            "πτόρθος — The penult ends in a consonant and carries the acute in this -θος example."],
           answer())
    field.fill("ἄνθρωπος")
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Acute on penult", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Manual penult moves the acute and preserves breathing",
           ["ἀνθρώπος", "ἄνθρωπος — sandbox acute on the penult."], answer())
    field.fill("Ξουθος")
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Acute on penult", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Manual penult treats ου as one syllable",
           ["Ξούθος", "Ξουθος — sandbox acute on the penult."], answer())
    field.fill("ἅλς")
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Acute on antepenult", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Manual mode reports an unavailable position and preserves spelling",
           ["ἅλς", "ἅλς — too few syllables for the antepenult."], answer())
    check("λόγος")
    record(checks, "Unlisted example stays unmodified",
           ["λόγος", "λόγος — outside the example list."], answer())
    record(checks, "Desktop cards fit side by side", [True, True],
           [fitting(frame), frame.locator(".card").first.bounding_box()["y"] ==
            frame.locator(".card").last.bounding_box()["y"]])

    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 320, "height": 760})
    frame.locator("#chips").get_by_role("button", name="πρωϊζός", exact=True).click()
    record(checks, "Narrow cards fit in one column and example chips work",
           [True, True, "πρωϊζός"],
           [fitting(frame), frame.locator(".card").last.bounding_box()["y"] >
            frame.locator(".card").first.bounding_box()["y"], visible(frame, "#outWord")])
    check("   ")
    record(checks, "Whitespace clears the result", ["—", prompt], answer())
    check("μυθος")
    frame.get_by_role("button", name="Clear").click()
    record(checks, "Clear empties and focuses the input and restores the empty state",
           ["", True, ["—", prompt]],
           [field.input_value(), field.evaluate("(node) => document.activeElement === node"),
            answer()])


def isolated_page(browser):
    context = browser.new_context(
        viewport={"width": 1100, "height": 800}, service_workers="block"
    )
    blocked_requests = []

    def deny(route):
        blocked_requests.append(route.request.resource_type)
        route.abort()

    context.route("**/*", deny)
    return context, context.new_page(), blocked_requests


def exercise(browser, item, scenarios):
    context, page, blocked_requests = isolated_page(browser)
    errors = []
    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append("page error"))
    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append("console error")
            if message.type == "error" else None)
    checks = []
    try:
        frame = mount(page, item)
        scenarios(page, frame, checks)
        record(checks, "Candidate made no external requests or browser errors",
               [[], []], [blocked_requests, errors])
        return checks
    finally:
        context.close()


def confinement(browser):
    # Only this test prefab refers to a reserved domain. The route aborts any request
    # that reaches interception, even if the production CSP fails to block it.
    probe = {
        "original": {"ref": "1.246", "greek_text": "", "english_translation": None},
        "candidate": {
            "html": '<form action="https://browser-probe.invalid/form">'
                    '<button type="submit">Test form policy</button></form>',
            "css": "",
            "js": """
                window.violations = [];
                document.addEventListener("securitypolicyviolation", (event) => {
                    window.violations.push({
                        directive: event.effectiveDirective, blocked: event.disposition
                    });
                });
                const img = document.createElement("img");
                img.alt = "";
                img.src = "https://browser-probe.invalid/image";
                document.body.append(img);
                fetch("https://browser-probe.invalid/connect").catch(() => {});
            """,
        },
    }
    context, page, blocked_requests = isolated_page(browser)
    checks = []
    try:
        frame = mount(page, probe)
        frame.get_by_role("button", name="Test form policy").click()
        iframe = page.locator(".gadget-frame")
        actual_frame = iframe.element_handle().content_frame()
        actual_frame.wait_for_function("window.violations && window.violations.length >= 3")
        violations = actual_frame.evaluate("window.violations")
        record(checks, "Production iframe and CSP enforce image, connection and form blocks",
               ["allow-scripts allow-forms", [
                   ["connect-src", "enforce"], ["form-action", "enforce"], ["img-src", "enforce"]
               ]],
               [iframe.get_attribute("sandbox"),
                sorted([event["directive"], event["blocked"]] for event in violations)])
        record(checks, "Confinement probes produced no outbound request or form navigation",
               [[], "about:srcdoc"], [blocked_requests, actual_frame.evaluate("document.URL")])
        return checks
    finally:
        context.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("bundle", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    bundle = json.loads(args.bundle.read_text())
    binary = which("chromium") or which("chromium-browser") or which("google-chrome")
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(
            executable_path=binary, args=["--disable-background-networking"]
        )
        try:
            security = confinement(browser)
            report = {}
            for role, scenarios in (("new", new_cases), ("past", past_cases)):
                item = bundle[role]
                checks = exercise(browser, item, scenarios) + security
                report[role] = {
                    "browser": f"Chromium {browser.version}",
                    "candidate_sha256": digest(item["candidate"]),
                    "assertions": checks,
                }
        finally:
            browser.close()
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
